description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of samples across ten different subtasks in the MMRA benchmark. Each slice is labeled with the subtask name, the absolute number of samples, and its corresponding percentage of the total dataset. The largest slice corresponds to “ObservationAngle,” with 126 samples (12.28%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” with 106 samples (10.33%). Other subtasks include “SubEvent” (100 samples, 9.74%), “UsageSimilarity” (100 samples, 9.65%), “Environment” (90 samples, 8.77%), “Layout” (90 samples, 8.77%), “AppearanceSimilarity” (90 samples, 8.77%), “SimilarEvent” (90 samples, 8.77%), “MentalitySimilarity” (89 samples, 8.67%), and “RelativePosition” (81 samples, 7.90%). The smallest slice is “NearSameEntity,” with 63 samples (6.34%). The chart uses distinct colors for each subtask and includes percentage labels inside each slice, visually emphasizing the relative proportions of each subtask within the benchmark.
